svg.title: Babul rings his bell and turns vehicles away from the low lane under a dry sky.
svg.desc: Babul angles his cycle van across the route arrow and warns bus, delivery, and clinic drivers to turn around. The sky is clear, but canal water has reached the lane's lowest edge.
svg.text: Page 41, panel 4 · Low-lane tracking shot as Babul turns vehicles away

text.tspan: Babul uses local authority and the manual warning to
divert drivers before the automated closure.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
